gloss: to organize; to put in order; to sort out

definitions.gloss: to organize; to put in order; to tidy up
definitions.explanation: To arrange things in a logical or orderly manner, whether physical objects on a desk, information for a report, or one's own thoughts and feelings.

definitions.gloss: to sort out; to consolidate; to dispose of what is unnecessary
definitions.explanation: To streamline by identifying and removing what is no longer needed, such as decluttering belongings, reducing staff, or eliminating redundant items.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}を{整理|せいり}した。
{情報|じょうほう}を{整理|せいり}してから{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please organize the information before reporting.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{前|まえ}に{論点|ろんてん}を{整理|せいり}しておかないと、{話|はなし}がまとまらない。
examples.english: If you don't organize the discussion points before the meeting, the conversation won't come together.

examples.japanese: {不要|ふよう}な{書類|しょるい}を{整理|せいり}する。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しを{機|き}に{荷物|にもつ}を{整理|せいり}して、{使|つか}わないものは{処分|しょぶん}した。
examples.english: I sorted through my belongings when moving and disposed of things I don't use.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{経営|けいえい}{不振|ふしん}のため、{人員|じんいん}{整理|せいり}を{行|おこな}わざるを{得|え}なくなった。
examples.english: Due to poor business performance, the company had no choice but to carry out staff reductions.

notes:
A very common and versatile verb meaning to bring order to something or to dispose of what is unnecessary. Combines {整|せい} (arrange, put in order) and {理|り} (reason, logic).

USAGE:
- Sense 1 focuses on arranging or ordering things: physical objects, information, thoughts
- Sense 2 focuses on streamlining by removing the unnecessary: decluttering, downsizing
- {人員|じんいん}{整理|せいり} (staff reduction) is a euphemism for layoffs
- {気持|きも}ちを{整理|せいり}する means to sort out one's feelings

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気持|きも}ちを{整理|せいり}する: to sort out one's feelings
- {情報|じょうほう}を{整理|せいり}する: to organize information
- {荷物|にもつ}を{整理|せいり}する: to sort through belongings
- {人員|じんいん}{整理|せいり}: staff reduction, downsizing
- {整理|せいり}{整頓|せいとん}: tidying up and organizing (set phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {片|かた}づける: to tidy up, to clean up — more casual and physical
- {整頓|せいとん}する: to put things in order — focuses on neatness and arrangement
- まとめる: to compile, to put together — focuses on bringing things together into a unified whole
- {分類|ぶんるい}する: to classify, to categorize — focuses on sorting into categories
